<title>实践项目 - AI Engineering from Scratch</title>

edits.before: Build real AI projects from simple to advanced. Every project ships a useful artifact, stage-by-stage tests, and a tutor. Open to community submissions.
edits.after: 从入门到进阶构建 AI 项目。每个项目交付可用成果，并提供阶段测试与导师指导。欢迎社区投稿。
实践项目 · AI Engineering from Scratch

edits.before: Build real AI projects from simple to advanced, graded stage by stage.
edits.after: 从入门到进阶构建 AI 项目，逐阶段验证。

edits.before: <aside class="translation-notice" lang="zh-CN" role="note">汉化进度：本次新增的 48 个实践项目已同步，项目正文、阶段说明及相关材料仍待增量汉化。详细范围记录在仓库的 i18n/zh-upstream-sync.json。</aside>
edits.after: <aside class="translation-notice" id="pjTranslationNotice" lang="zh-CN" role="note">正在读取汉化清单。项目主体内容、运行验证和视觉验收分别记录在 i18n/zh-upstream-sync.json。</aside>
>实践项目 · 从入门到进阶<

edits.before: Each project turns course lessons into a working artifact: a report generator, a memory server, a task queue, an agent. You build it stage by stage, a grader checks every stage, and a tutor walks you through it.
edits.after: 将课程知识变成可运行的交付物：报告生成器、记忆服务器、任务队列或智能体。你逐阶段构建，评分器检查各阶段，导师提供学习指导。

edits.before: Choose Python, Rust, TypeScript, or Go for the job. Core tests run offline; optional framework labs list their dependencies.
edits.after: 根据任务选择 Python、Rust、TypeScript 或 Go。核心测试可离线运行；可选框架实验会列明依赖。

edits.before: Copy the starter files. Each stub gives you the exact signature to implement.
edits.after: 复制起始文件。每个占位函数都给出需要实现的精确签名。

edits.before: Build one stage at a time. The grader checks your work and every earlier stage.
edits.after: 每次构建一个阶段。评分器检查当前实现及全部前置阶段。

edits.before: Want guidance? In Claude Code, work through each stage with hints and feedback.
edits.after: 在 Claude Code 中按阶段学习，获取提示和反馈。

edits.before: Five levels. Each adds one new kind of engineering. New projects join a level as they are written or submitted.
edits.after: 共五个级别，每级增加一类工程能力。新编写或提交的项目会加入对应级别。

edits.before: Built something useful? Add it to the ladder.
edits.after: 把你的实用项目加入目录。

edits.before: Community projects use the same layout as core ones: a project.json, stages with a lesson, a starter, and tests, plus a reference solution. They appear here with your GitHub handle.
edits.after: 社区项目与核心项目采用相同结构：project.json、包含课程正文、起始代码和测试的各阶段，以及参考实现。项目会展示你的 GitHub 用户名。

edits.before: Produces a real artifact, not a chat demo
edits.after: 交付可用成果，不只演示聊天

edits.before: Every stage has tests that pass offline, with no API key
edits.after: 每个阶段都有可离线通过的测试，无需 API 密钥

edits.before: Independent evaluation fixtures and clear limits on what the score proves
edits.after: 提供独立评估夹具，并说明分数能够证明什么

edits.before: Original implementations with links to official specs and research
edits.after: 提供原创实现，并链接官方规范与研究资料

edits.before: After copying, set id in projects/my-project/project.json to my-project before running the grader.
edits.after: 复制后，先将 projects/my-project/project.json 中的 id 设为 my-project，再运行评分器。

edits.before: AI Engineering from Scratch · open source · free forever.
edits.after: AI Engineering from Scratch · 开源 · 永久免费。

edits.before: A real AI project built stage by stage, with tests for every stage and a tutor.
edits.after: 逐阶段构建 AI 项目，每个阶段都有测试与导师指导。

plannedLabels.title: Bookmark Path Organizer
plannedLabels.tagline: Make a useful reading path from saved links.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 将收藏链接整理成实用的阅读路径。

plannedLabels.title: CSV Repair Workbench
plannedLabels.tagline: Fix messy tables without losing the original cells.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 修复杂乱表格，同时保留原始单元格。

plannedLabels.title: Download Folder Sort Desk
plannedLabels.tagline: Turn a crowded folder into a reviewable filing plan.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 将拥挤的目录整理成可审阅的归档计划。

plannedLabels.title: Glossary Hovercard Publisher
plannedLabels.tagline: Explain unfamiliar terms inside the page people are reading.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 在读者当前页面中解释陌生术语。

plannedLabels.title: Photo Burst Contact Sheet
plannedLabels.tagline: Compare similar photos before choosing what to keep.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 先对比相似照片，再决定保留哪些。

plannedLabels.title: Vocabulary Autocomplete Pad
plannedLabels.tagline: Build suggestions that explain which words they learned from.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 生成建议，并说明建议来自哪些已学习的词语。

plannedLabels.title: API Tutorial Runner
plannedLabels.tagline: Check that an API tutorial still works from its first request to its final result.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 从第一个请求到最终结果，检查 API 教程是否仍能运行。

plannedLabels.title: Catalog Record Linker
plannedLabels.tagline: Reconcile two catalogs without silently merging different things.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 核对两份目录，避免把不同对象静默合并。

plannedLabels.title: Chart Storyboard Builder
plannedLabels.tagline: Turn a table into a visual explanation people can inspect.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 将表格转成可检查的可视化说明。

plannedLabels.title: Configuration Drift Explainer
plannedLabels.tagline: Explain why two environments resolve the same setting differently.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 解释两个环境为何将同一设置解析为不同结果。

plannedLabels.title: Dependency Upgrade Impact Map
plannedLabels.tagline: Show which call sites need attention when a dependency contract changes.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 依赖契约变化时，指出需要检查的调用位置。

plannedLabels.title: Diagram Reading Companion
plannedLabels.tagline: Give a diagram an inspectable reading order and explanation.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 为图解提供可检查的阅读顺序和说明。

plannedLabels.title: Field Notes Map Builder
plannedLabels.tagline: Turn location-tagged observations into a map another tool can use.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 将带位置标记的观察记录转成其他工具可用的地图。

plannedLabels.title: Gesture Shortcut Pad
plannedLabels.tagline: Teach a small app your own drawn shortcuts.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 让小型应用学习你自定义的绘制手势。

plannedLabels.title: Infrastructure Plan Explainer
plannedLabels.tagline: Explain replacements, unknown values and dependencies before an infrastructure change.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 在基础设施变更前，解释替换操作、未知值和依赖关系。

plannedLabels.title: Log Volume Reduction Lab
plannedLabels.tagline: Shrink a noisy log stream while keeping evidence of rare failures.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 减少日志噪声，同时保留罕见故障的证据。

plannedLabels.title: Plain Language Rewrite Desk
plannedLabels.tagline: Make an explanation easier to read while checking what changed.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 让说明更易读，同时检查改写改变了什么。

plannedLabels.title: Service Ownership Navigator
plannedLabels.tagline: Find a service's owner and runbook with evidence for every answer.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 查找服务责任人和操作手册，并为每项答案保留证据。

plannedLabels.title: Subtitle Localization Desk
plannedLabels.tagline: Translate captions while keeping the timing and terminology visible.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 翻译字幕，同时保留可检查的时间和术语。

plannedLabels.title: UI String Localization Workbench
plannedLabels.localizedTitle: 界面字符串本地化工作台
plannedLabels.tagline: Review translated interface text without breaking its placeholders.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 审阅界面译文，避免破坏占位符。

plannedLabels.title: Workshop Materials Planner
plannedLabels.tagline: Scale a workshop plan and show exactly which supplies are missing.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 按规模调整活动计划，并列明缺少的物资。

plannedLabels.title: CI Failure Reproducer
plannedLabels.tagline: Turn a failed build log into a small, reviewable reproduction recipe.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 将构建失败日志转成简明、可审阅的复现步骤。

plannedLabels.title: Community Learning Path Finder
plannedLabels.tagline: Build a learning path that explains its prerequisites and tradeoffs.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 构建学习路径，并解释先修要求和取舍。

plannedLabels.title: Database Migration Rehearsal
plannedLabels.tagline: Rehearse a proposed migration on a copy and show exactly what changes.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 在副本上演练拟议迁移，并展示精确变化。

plannedLabels.title: Decision Tradeoff Explorer
plannedLabels.tagline: Show when a different priority changes the preferred option.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 展示优先级变化何时会改变首选方案。

plannedLabels.title: Kubernetes Event Storyboard
plannedLabels.tagline: Turn workload events into a timeline with the exact objects behind each clue.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 将工作负载事件整理成时间线，并关联每条线索背后的对象。

plannedLabels.title: Label Adjudication Desk
plannedLabels.tagline: Turn annotator disagreements into a traceable evaluation dataset.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 将标注分歧整理为可追踪的评估数据集。

plannedLabels.title: Lost Item Match Desk
plannedLabels.tagline: Compare likely item matches without pretending a score proves ownership.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 比较可能匹配的物品，不把分数当作所有权证明。

plannedLabels.title: Presentation Rehearsal Coach
plannedLabels.tagline: See which slide ideas your rehearsal actually covered.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 检查排练实际覆盖了哪些幻灯片要点。

plannedLabels.title: Retry Storm Lab
plannedLabels.tagline: Watch many reasonable retries combine into an overloaded service.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 观察多个单独合理的重试如何共同造成服务过载。

plannedLabels.title: Semantic Cache Correctness Lab
plannedLabels.localizedTitle: 语义缓存正确性实验室
plannedLabels.tagline: Measure when a similar question can reuse an answer and when it must miss.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 测量相似问题何时能复用答案、何时必须重新处理。

plannedLabels.title: Streaming Answer Recovery
plannedLabels.tagline: Reconnect a streamed answer without duplicating text or hiding an incomplete result.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 恢复中断的流式回答，避免重复文本或隐藏未完成结果。

plannedLabels.title: Tool Contract Migration Checker
plannedLabels.tagline: Find the saved tool calls that a proposed schema change would break.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 找出拟议模式变更会破坏的已保存工具调用。

plannedLabels.title: Video Highlight Storyboard
plannedLabels.tagline: Review a clip sequence before spending time editing video.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 先审阅片段顺序，再投入视频剪辑。

plannedLabels.title: A2A Task Handoff Workbench
plannedLabels.tagline: Trace a task as two independently running agents exchange work and artifacts.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 追踪两个独立运行的智能体如何交换任务和交付物。

plannedLabels.title: Abstention Calibration Workbench
plannedLabels.tagline: Choose when an assistant should defer using a measured error-versus-coverage tradeoff.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 通过实测错误率与覆盖率的取舍，确定助手何时应暂缓回答。

plannedLabels.title: Artifact Provenance Gate
plannedLabels.tagline: Explain whether an artifact matches its signed build record and your trust policy.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 检查交付物是否匹配签名构建记录和你的信任策略。

plannedLabels.title: Context Compaction Verifier
plannedLabels.tagline: Check which task constraints survive when an agent compresses its working context.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 检查智能体压缩工作上下文后，哪些任务约束仍被保留。

plannedLabels.title: Hedged Request Lab
plannedLabels.tagline: Measure the extra work required to escape a slow read request.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 测量为避开缓慢读取请求而增加的工作量。

plannedLabels.title: Local Inference Capacity Planner
plannedLabels.tagline: Measure how concurrency changes queueing, latency and successful local requests.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 测量并发如何影响排队、延迟和本地请求成功数量。

plannedLabels.title: MCP Compatibility Doctor
plannedLabels.tagline: Find the first protocol disagreement between an MCP client and server.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 找出 MCP 客户端和服务器之间的第一个协议分歧。

plannedLabels.title: Metamorphic Evaluation Workbench
plannedLabels.tagline: Test relationships between answers when a single golden answer is not enough.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 单个标准答案不足时，测试不同答案之间应满足的关系。

plannedLabels.title: OAuth Resource Boundary Lab
plannedLabels.tagline: Show why a valid token can still be wrong for the requested resource.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 说明有效令牌为何仍可能不适用于请求的资源。

plannedLabels.title: Outbound Request Policy Proxy
plannedLabels.tagline: Explain every destination decision before an agent's HTTP request leaves the process.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 在智能体 HTTP 请求离开进程前，解释每项目标地址决策。

plannedLabels.title: Release Canary Decision Lab
plannedLabels.tagline: Make a candidate release earn more traffic through visible evidence and stopping rules.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 依据可见证据和停止规则，决定是否给候选版本更多流量。

plannedLabels.title: Secret Injection Sidecar
plannedLabels.tagline: Let an agent request an authenticated operation using an opaque credential handle.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 让智能体通过不透明凭据句柄请求需要认证的操作。

plannedLabels.title: Signed Webhook Inbox
plannedLabels.tagline: Accept a delivery once and retain the evidence needed to replay it safely.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 仅接收一次投递，并保留安全重放所需的证据。

plannedLabels.title: Tenant Fairness Scheduler
plannedLabels.tagline: Keep one busy tenant from consuming the entire agent execution queue.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 避免一个繁忙租户耗尽整个智能体执行队列。

plannedLabels.title: Agent Resource Deadlock Lab
plannedLabels.localizedTitle: 智能体资源死锁实验室
plannedLabels.tagline: Replay the exact resource-acquisition order that leaves cooperating agents stuck.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 重放导致协作智能体卡住的精确资源获取顺序。

plannedLabels.title: Judge Bias Calibration Lab
plannedLabels.localizedTitle: 评审器偏差校准实验室
plannedLabels.tagline: Find when a judge prefers answer position or length over the evidence in its rubric.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 找出评审器何时偏好答案位置或长度，而忽略评分标准中的证据。

plannedLabels.title: Trajectory Counterexample Minimizer
plannedLabels.tagline: Reduce a long agent run to the smallest event sequence that still breaks a rule.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 将长智能体运行缩减为仍会违反规则的最短事件序列。

plannedLabels.title: Transactional Workspace Patch Broker
plannedLabels.localizedTitle: 事务式工作区补丁协调器
plannedLabels.tagline: Publish a coordinated set of agent edits only when its input revision still matches.
plannedLabels.localizedTagline: 仅在输入版本仍匹配时，发布一组相互协调的智能体修改。
